authorization.basis: The prospectively frozen result completed, the frozen-protocol-bound CPU replay passed, the terminal ledger verified, and a separate read-only acceptance audit reproduced the replay and checked the frozen manifest, slot-coordinate bindings, live-wire receipts, process separation, lifecycle counts, model steps, and kernel-ledger receipts.
authorization.authorized_claim: On one fixed Qwen3.5/H20 stack, spawn-created observer processes imported the frozen live GDN tensor views through PyTorch CUDA-IPC reduction and independently reconstructed their storage descriptors and pair relations without receiving live candidate rows, phase/policy/completion labels, or verdict labels; the frozen CPU replay bound those raw observations to the preregistered plan and passed both N=2 three-phase lifecycle verdicts.

postexecution_acceptance_boundary: This acceptance is a read-only postexecution verification of immutable raw and replay artifacts. The frozen replay itself did not explicitly enforce the live-slot receipt, deterministic manifest-to-row binding, model-step count, or kernel-ledger conditions; this acceptance checked those archived fields separately and does not retroactively change the frozen replay source.
